purpose: Reads the master catalogue of contact kinds and the holder's own additions, with caches.
namedChanges: The imports are the five peers `contact-kind-model`, `lws-relations`, `lws-vault-sets`, `term-origin` and `term-slots`.
`const MASTER_BASE = `${GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN}/base`;` (built when the module loaded) is `function masterBase(): string { return `${termOrigin()}/base`; }`; its uses are `masterBase()`.

The interface `OwnKindsHost` is added and exported; `readOwnKinds`, `readOwnEntryName` and `addOwnKind` take `host: OwnKindsHost` as their first argument, and `getResource(` and `createResource(` are `host.getResource(` and `host.createResource(` with the same arguments.

Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling, a measuring rig or the host app are reworded; no code changed. One string literal carries an app step tag: `USER_VOCAB_KEY` (`"s5c-user-link-plane"`), kept as it is.

host.replaces: getResource(id, vaultId, entityUri) and getResource(tail, vaultId, id), GilbApp src/lib/contact/ownKinds.ts:77 and :91 (src/lib/mynet/place/lws.ts:57)
